name: agent-browser
description: Lets coding agents drive Chrome from a native Rust CLI or stdio MCP server, using accessibility snapshots with element refs, semantic locators, and saved login state.

skills.name: Snapshot And Refs
skills.description: Captures the page accessibility tree with element refs, then clicks, fills, and reads elements by ref or by locators such as role and label.

skills.name: Agent-Friendly Reading
skills.description: Reads a URL as markdown without launching Chrome, or the active tab's rendered DOM, with outline, filter, llms.txt, and JSON output options.

skills.name: Snapshot And Visual Diff
skills.description: Compares accessibility snapshots or screenshots against a saved baseline, or two URLs against each other, to show what changed on a page.

skills.name: MCP Tool Profiles
skills.description: Starts a stdio MCP server whose tool profiles, such as core, network, and react, keep the tool list small or expose full CLI parity.

skills.name: Login State Persistence
skills.description: Reuses Chrome profiles, saved state files, restored sessions, or an encrypted local credential vault so agents skip logging in on every run.
